subject: ldply - is there a way to change name of .id column?

messages.author: 49b995d6a750a593
messages.subject: ldply - is there a way to change name of .id column?
parts:
When using ldply with named list the final data.frame contain .id
column with names of an input list:

L <- list(a=iris[,1:2], b=iris[,1:2], c=iris[,1:2])
ldply(L,head,2)

.id Sepal.Length Sepal.Width
1 a 5.1 3.5
2 a 4.9 3.0
3 b 5.1 3.5
4 b 4.9 3.0
5 c 5.1 3.5
6 c 4.9 3.0

Is there way (a parameter) to change default column name (.id)? Of
course other than

names(result)[1] <- "My_name"

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: ldply - is there a way to change name of .id column?
parts:
Not currently, no. I'm not sure of an elegant way to express this.

Hadley
